people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Then I said, “Lord Yahweh, stop, I beg you! How could Jacob stand? For he is small.”
translations.bsb: Then I said, “Lord GOD, please stop! How will Jacob survive, since he is so small?”
translations.kjv: Then said I, O Lord GOD, cease, I beseech thee: by whom shall Jacob arise? for he is small.
translations.asv: Then said I, O Lord Jehovah, cease, I beseech thee: how shall Jacob stand? for he is small.
